Select: molecule_chembl_id, molecule_name, max_phase, molecule_type, canonical_smiles. Source: molecule_dictionary, compound_records, compound_structures, docs. Join: molecule_dictionary to compound_records on molregno, compound_records to docs on doc_id, molecule_dictionary to compound_structures on molregno. Filter: docs.chembl_id equals 'CHEMBL1129278'. Sort: molecule_chembl_id ascending.
